mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (particularly hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia) which can lower seizure threshold and reduce clobazam efficacy, while clobazam may have additive CNS depression effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes closely, maintain adequate renal function monitoring, and assess seizure control; consider alternative antifungal if possible or adjust clobazam dosing based on seizure breakthrough and electrolyte status.
